name: Innovation Inc.
summary: Innovation Inc. provides B2B marketing strategy support services in Japan. The company offers online media and sales cloud services. It offers online media services, including IT Trend, a comparison site that offers information about IT products and services; and Biz Trend, a comparison site that offers information about business solutions for personnel in charge of human resources, general affairs, marketing, etc. The company also provides marketing automation service through List Finder, a B2B focused Web analytics tool; and online sales services through Sales Doc, an online sales tool. In addition, it offers Seminar Self, a seminar video platform. Innovation Inc. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
